meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

examples.trans: Hi, Arkady Borisovich. What are you doing?

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

examples.text: Он за мной после концерта ухаживал.
examples.trans: He courted me after a concert once.

examples.text: Он за мной после концерта ухаживал. В Москву звал замуж!
examples.trans: He courted me after a concert once. He asked me to marry him and come to Moscow!

meanings.note: после вчерашнего = after what happened yesterday

examples.text: Ты что здесь делаешь? После вчерашнего!
examples.trans: What are you doing here? After yesterday!

examples.text: А то ты вчерашний вечер не помнишь?
examples.trans: As if you don't remember last night?

meanings.note: Как вы знаете = as you know.

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
Present есть; у меня есть = I have.

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
You are wrong in this argument.

examples.text: Был неправ. Простите. Я хочу закончить начатое.
examples.trans: I was wrong. Forgive me. I want to finish what I started.
If you don't want to, suit yourself.
They want to build a shopping centre there.

meanings.en: to finish, to end, to complete

examples.trans: I want to finish what I started.

examples.text: Был неправ. Простите. Я хочу закончить начатое.
examples.trans: I was wrong. Forgive me. I want to finish what I started.

meanings.en: what was started, the work begun
meanings.note: neuter past participle of начать used as a noun

examples.trans: I want to finish what I started.

examples.text: Он всегда доводит начатое до конца.
examples.trans: He always sees what he started through to the end.

examples.text: Был неправ. Простите. Я хочу закончить начатое.
examples.trans: I was wrong. Forgive me. I want to finish what I started.

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда через две недели. Я решу все ваши проблемы.
examples.trans: I'll be out of here in two weeks. I'll solve all your problems.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.
Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: 'что я за мэр такой' = what kind of mayor am I
pointing at something a little way off
Вон отсюда! = get out of here!

examples.trans: I love our town very much.
You're in love with another man's wife!

examples.text: Твоя жена очень мудрая женщина. Ты её слушай.
examples.trans: Your wife is a very wise woman. You listen to her.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?
Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?

meanings.note: Also a flat number in an address.

examples.trans: Do you remember the toilet in the communal flat?

meanings.en: что ли = or what, I suppose

examples.trans: I don't know whether he is at home.
Was it Osipenko who hired you?

meanings.note: + genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice

examples.text: Она нашла нас на новом месте.
examples.trans: She found us at the new place.
That is it, she got really offended.
She is not answering her phone.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: used only of a woman: быть замужем за кем (instr.)

examples.trans: She has been married for a long time.

examples.text: Она же замужем! Ты любишь чужую жену!
examples.trans: But she's married! You love another man's wife!

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

meanings.note: С первого раза = the first time.

examples.text: Ты не понимаешь с первого раза?
examples.trans: You don't understand the first time?

examples.text: Ты что, с первого раза не понимаешь?
examples.trans: What, you don't understand the first time?

meanings.note: просить прощения = to ask for forgiveness

examples.text: Когда вырасту, ты будешь просить у меня прощения!
examples.trans: When I grow up, you'll be begging me to forgive you!

meanings.note: Оставь мне кусок = save me a piece.

examples.trans: I won't leave him on his own.

examples.text: Вика, ну он одинокий. Я же не оставлю его одного.
examples.trans: Vika, come on, he's all alone. I can't just leave him on his own.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

examples.text: Как? Ты?! А как же адвокатская тайна?
examples.trans: How? You?! What about lawyer-client secrecy?

examples.text: Виктор Степанович, сегодня никак не могу.
examples.trans: Viktor Stepanovich, I really can't today.

meanings.note: ironic: Сталину расскажите = tell that to Stalin

examples.trans: There's someone here to see you.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, извините, тут к вам человек.
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, I'm sorry, there's a man here to see you.

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.en: to have a look, to take a look

examples.trans: Can I go and have a look?
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.
Why are we going so slowly?

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!

meanings.note: in greetings: добрый день, добрый вечер

examples.text: Добрый вечер, Вика. С Новым годом!
examples.trans: Good evening, Vika. Happy New Year!

examples.text: Какое хорошее утро! Лидия Алексеевна, чашку кофе, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: What a lovely morning! Lidia Alekseyevna, a cup of coffee, please.

проходить.gloss: to go through; to come in

examples.text: Вика, Паша! Как я рад. Проходите, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: Vika, Pasha! I'm so glad. Come in, please.

присесть.gloss: to sit down (for a moment), to take a seat

meanings.en: to sit down, to have a seat

examples.trans: He sat down on the chair.

examples.text: Марина Сергеевна, присядьте. Попробуйте чай с сушками, очень вкусные.
examples.trans: Marina Sergeyevna, have a seat. Try the tea with bread rings, they're very tasty.

перекусить.gloss: to have a bite to eat, to grab a snack

meanings.en: to have a quick bite to eat, to snack

examples.trans: Come in, sit down, have a bite to eat.
Let's grab a bite before the trip.

examples.text: Доброе утро, Аркадий Борисович. Проходи, присядь, перекуси.
examples.trans: Good morning, Arkady Borisovich. Come in, sit down, have a bite to eat.

related.gloss: to have a bite to eat
